title: Antidiabetic potential of Abelmoschus esculentus leaves and fruits: a comparative study assisted by chemical profiling, in vitro and in silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18292-18309
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08509D, Paper
Open Access

Ahlam Hashem Elwekeel, Elham Amin, Ahmed M. Sayed, Marwa H. A. Hassan
Abelmoschus esculentus (L.) extracts were studied using phytochemical analysis (GC-MS, LC-HRMS/MS). Additionally in vitro determination of the antioxidant capacity and the inhibitory potential of the extracts against α-glucosidase, α-amylase, dipeptidyl-peptidase-4 and lipase enzymes was conducted.
